indicator_name: National Bank deposit auctions: volume placed, number of auctions and volume-weighted yield, monthly
description: Депозитные аукционы Национального Банка: объём размещения, число аукционов и средневзвешенная доходность, помесячно
unit: VOLUME billion KZT; N auctions; YIELD %
methodology: Sum over the auctions of the month (by auction date) of the NBK's xlsx export, 2019-02 onward. YIELD is weighted by the volume placed. The stock outstanding is NBK_OPEN_POSITION's DEPOSIT_AUCTION.
